posts.post_subject: Frustration at Ebay in Pursuit of $10,000
posts.content_md: I just lost out on the bidding for a hologram of a $10,000 bill because I couldn't connect with Ebay in time. I wouldn't have won it because I wouldn't have gone over $100 (since I already have two of them), but I'm really frustrated because while the time was ticking away all I could do was watch the little computer icons in the corner NOT blinking! I tried re-dialing and re-booting to no avail. Then I saw the closing price ($130)and was relieved.
